snippet.title: NABERON – the colony surface comes alive
snippet.description:
Every colony in NABERON now grows into a small town: roads, sidewalks, street lamps, cars parking and driving, and citizens walking and chatting around the buildings. Real-time space 4X, free demo on Steam on October 8.
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5162720/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=surface_1006
